title: Crispy Potato Tacos
instructions: Preheat oven: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Lightly oil two large rimmed baking sheets.

Parboil potatoes: Peel and dice 5 pounds russet potatoes (5 lbs) into ¾-inch chunks. Rinse in cold water. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add potatoes, and boil for 5–6 minutes  — they should still feel slightly firm when pierced.
Dry the potatoes: Drain in a strainer and let sit for about 3 minutes until dry. Shake the strainer to rough up the surface starch — this is key to crispiness.

Season: In a very large bowl, toss the parboiled potatoes with 0.4 cups olive oil, 3 tablespoons cornstarch, 1.5 tablespoons granulated onion powder, 1.5 tablespoons granulated garlic powder, 1.5 teaspoons ground cumin, 1.5 teaspoons paprika, 1.5 teaspoons salt, and coat thoroughly.
Arrange on sheets: Spread the coated potatoes in a single layer across both prepared baking sheets. Do not crowd them.
Bake: Bake for 40–42 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve: Serve in warmed 12 small soft tortillas topped with 1.5 cups shredded vegan cheddar cheese, 3 cups shredded lettuce, 0.8 cups diced tomatoes, and plenty of 0.4 cups chipotle sauce. Enjoy!
